profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at CISA
profile.summary: Mitchel holds a BS in Computer Science from San Francisco State University and is an engineer with a strong track record of solving technical and business challenges.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software engineer for the Secure Cloud Business Applications (SCuBA) project at the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), providing cloud security guidance and automation tools to assess the configuration state of Microsoft 365/GWS tenants in the federal government.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Troop 74, Boy Scouts of America · May 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: Led an Eagle Project donating 300+ clothing items to the COTS homeless shelter of Petaluma.
